name: Sky Carrier Catwalk
prompt: A WIDE 16:9 landscape environment backdrop for the SECOND room of a 2.5D beat-'em-up aboard a colossal FLYING AIRCRAFT CARRIER: a narrow exposed CATWALK / gangway running left-to-right between deck sections, high in a bright daytime sky. Steel grating underfoot hint, riveted side rails and support struts, cargo containers and a crane arm off to one side, antenna masts, yellow hazard chevrons. Behind and below: layered drifting clouds and a distant hazy horizon selling the altitude and the drop. Gritty indie-arcade / dark-comic HD cel-shaded, thick uneven outlines, flat cel shading, desaturated steel palette, dramatic rim light. NO characters, NO UI, NO frame, NO floor plane in front — just the environment, full-bleed, as a game background.
cardartAction: a tense narrow catwalk between deck towers, containers and a crane, clouds streaming past below

name: Sky Carrier Arena Mouth
